description: Named hard clips for torso/orientation failure modes. Used by run_cached_validation --hard-clips to filter the cached CMU eval to the regression cases called out in PLAN.md (look-back during backward walking, walk-while-turning-head, seated, lying-down). Each entry: clip id -> reason and failure_mode tag.

69_34.reason: walk backwards and turn: torso must hold facing while trajectory reverses and head turns

69_50.reason: walk sideways and backwards: sign-ambiguous trajectory

40_02.reason: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal

41_02.reason: navigate - walk forward, backward, sideways, on a diagonal

139_01.reason: looking around: sustained head-torso yaw divergence in place

91_18.reason: careful walk while looking around: head yaw diverges from trajectory

86_09.reason: walking, sitting, looking, stand up: seated transition plus look

13_01.reason: sit on high stool, stand up

14_29.reason: sit on stepstool, stand up, swing legs

111_12.reason: lay down: head-forward approaches gravity, both dual frames break

77_18.reason: laying down on back, getting up
